label: PROSPECTIVE STUDY under docs/competence_ceiling_protocol.md (Step B2). Oracle O is evaluator-only; OFF-feature and OFF-feature-all are PRIVILEGED CEILINGS, never candidate learners.

privileged_ceilings.OFF-feature: PRIVILEGED PERCEPTION CEILING: exact latent features (reserves, factors, cue signals); never a candidate learner
privileged_ceilings.OFF-feature-all: PRIVILEGED PERCEPTION AND LABELS CEILING: exact latent features and all five actions' counterfactual labels; descriptive only, never a candidate learner

R1_calibration.rule: OFF-feature seed-mean excess at N=8192 > 0.01 => the "0.01 over O" bar is infeasible at this N

R2_decomposition.rule: dominant if >= 50% of ON-ref seed-mean excess and positive in >= 10/12 seeds; otherwise mixed
R2_decomposition.implication: Q dominant: the single-pass online update rule limits competence; next is online consolidation (weight averaging, slow/fast weights), then tested against plasticity under law switches.

R3_replay_retest.rule: confirmed if ON-R256 removes >= 25% of ON-ref seed-mean excess and reduces it in >= 10/12 seeds

R4_weight_averaging.rule: EMA helps if ON-R256-EMA removes >= 25% of ON-R256 seed-mean excess and reduces it in >= 10/12 seeds
